title: The Girl
author: Boby Borah
text:
When the sun is away
Behind the darkness
The stars stare
The dry eyes of the girl
Who wanted to be a river.

In aquatic excitement of
Jazzy water body,
The unseen stream
Where the boat
Doesn`t pushed across,
The flowery anchal
Shines in alluvial island
Thrown away by the girl.

Sprinkle the moonlit
The moon goes away,
The indifferent wind carries
The indistinct cry of night jasmine.

Searching a trisul
The girl has been waiting devotedly
In the river side
To become Durga .
